# Jason — Designer & Software Engineer

> Minimalist editorial portfolio of Jason, designer and frontend software engineer crafting high-performance, resilient, and human-centered digital products.

## About & Profile

Jason is a designer and software engineer with over 5 years of craft experience bridging the gap between meticulous UI/UX architecture and robust frontend engineering. With over 30 shipped production releases and products serving 100k+ active users, Jason focuses on reducing complexity and building durable, elegant software.

- **Role**: Product Designer & Lead Frontend Engineer
- **Experience**: 5+ years of craft
- **Shipped Products**: 30+ production releases
- **Active User Impact**: 100k+ users interacting with delivered software daily
- **Performance Standard**: 99.9% performance score (zero bloat, highly accessible)
- **Primary Social / Instagram**: https://instagram.com/jasonn.doc
- **GitHub**: https://github.com

---

## Core Principles & Design Philosophy

1. **Say less, tell more**: Brevity and intentionality over ornamental noise.
2. **Simplicity is the hardest work**: Eliminating non-essentials until only meaning remains.
3. **Every detail is an intention**: Every pixel, transition, and line of code must justify its existence with purpose.
4. **Consistency builds trust**: Mathematical typography scales and coherent tokenized design systems.
5. **Haste ruins the beautiful**: Taking the time to craft lasting, reliable experiences.

## Featured Projects & Case Studies

### 1. Zylo — High-Performance Cloud & Web Hosting Platform
- **URL**: [/project/zylo](/project/zylo) (Live: https://zylo.ai)
- **Category**: Cloud Infrastructure & Web Hosting
- **Role**: Founder & Lead Architect
- **Year**: 2025
- **Tech Stack**: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Docker, Edge CDN, Figma
- **Metrics**: 99.99% uptime SLA, < 180ms global TTFB, 10,000+ active websites hosted
- **Summary**: Full-stack web hosting and deployment platform featuring real-time server telemetry (CPU/RAM/Bandwidth), automated SSL provisioning, 1-click Git deployment webhooks, and wildcard DNS routing.

### 2. Trufin — Fintech Risk Intelligence & Legal Entity Verification
- **URL**: [/project/trufin](/project/trufin) (Live: https://trufin.io)
- **Category**: Fintech Security & Institutional Verification
- **Role**: Lead Product Designer & Frontend Engineer
- **Year**: 2025
- **Tech Stack**: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, REST API, Search Indexer, Figma
- **Metrics**: 100% verified regulatory registry cross-matching, < 0.2s instant search, 50k+ flagged fraudulent entities
- **Summary**: Public intelligence and verification engine allowing citizens and businesses to verify official financial institution licensing and detect predatory illegal lending clones in real time.

### 3. Krigstudio — Interactive Digital Invitation & Event Platform
- **URL**: [/project/krigstudio](/project/krigstudio) (Live: https://krigstudio.com)
- **Category**: Event Web Platform & Digital Invitations
- **Role**: Creator & Lead Frontend Developer
- **Year**: 2024
- **Tech Stack**: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Web Audio API, Figma
- **Metrics**: 95% RSVP confirmation rate, 60 FPS smooth mobile animations, 500+ celebrated weddings & events
- **Summary**: Interactive bespoke event platform featuring dynamic personalized guest covers, real-time RSVP guestbooks, digital gift/bank transfers with dynamic QR codes, spatial background audio, and Google Maps routing.

## Core Services

- **Product & UI/UX Design**: Wireframing, human-centered user flows, Figma design systems, interactive high-fidelity prototyping, and UI/UX design audits.
- **Frontend Engineering**: Blazingly fast client-side applications built with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Motion UI, and performance optimizations.
- **Design Systems & Tokenization**: Atomic component libraries, design tokens, WCAG AA accessibility compliance, and interactive documentation.
- **Digital Brand Identity & Micro-Interactions**: Bespoke typography pairings, fluid 60fps micro-animations, tactile sound/visual feedback, and brand guidelines.
